title: उत्तरपर्व · अध्याय ९१

items.text:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
अम्बुपूर्णतडागेषु महातोयाशयेषु च ॥
कस्यार्थं सम्प्रयच्छंति कृष्णैताः कुलयोषितः ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
|| yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || ||
ambupūrṇataḍāgeṣu mahātoyāśayeṣu ca ||
kasyārthaṃ samprayacchaṃti kṛṣṇaitāḥ kulayoṣitaḥ || 1 ||

items.text:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ।
मासि भाद्रपदे प्राप्ते शुक्ले भूततिथौ नृप ॥
तडागपाल्यां दातव्यं वरुणायार्घ्यमुत्तमम् ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || |
māsi bhādrapade prāpte śukle bhūtatithau nṛpa ||
taḍāgapālyāṃ dātavyaṃ varuṇāyārghyamuttamam || 2 ||

items.text:
ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर्वैश्यैः शूद्रैः स्त्रीभिस्तथैव च ॥
तस्मिन्दिने भक्तिनम्रैर्देयादर्घ्यं युधिष्ठिर ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiḥ strībhistathaiva ca ||
tasmindine bhaktinamrairdeyādarghyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira || 3 ||

items.text:
आलिख्य मण्डले देवं वरुणं वारुणीयुतम् ॥
मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र पूजयेद्भक्तिभावतः ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
ālikhya maṇḍale devaṃ varuṇaṃ vāruṇīyutam ||
maṃtreṇānena rājendra pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ || 6 ||

items.text:
वरुणाय नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्ते यादसांपते ॥
अपांपते नमस्तेऽस्तु रसानांपतये नमः ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
varuṇāya namastubhyaṃ namaste yādasāṃpate ||
apāṃpate namaste'stu rasānāṃpataye namaḥ || 7 ||

items.text:
मा क्लेदं मा च दौर्गंध्यं विरस्यं मा मुखेऽस्तु मे ॥
वरुणो वारुणीभर्ता वरदोऽस्तु सदा मम ( स्वाहा) ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
mā kledaṃ mā ca daurgaṃdhyaṃ virasyaṃ mā mukhe'stu me ||
varuṇo vāruṇībhartā varado'stu sadā mama ( svāhā) || 8 ||

items.text:
एवं यः पूजयेद्भक्त्या वरुणं वरुणालयम् ॥
मध्याह्ने सरसि स्नात्वा नग्निपाकी व्रती नृप ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ yaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā varuṇaṃ varuṇālayam ||
madhyāhne sarasi snātvā nagnipākī vratī nṛpa || 9 ||

items.text:
चातुर्वर्ण्यथ वै नारी व्रतेनानेन पांडव ॥
नैवेद्यं ब्राह्मणे देयं यन्नैवेद्ये प्रकल्पितम् ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
cāturvarṇyatha vai nārī vratenānena pāṃḍava ||
naivedyaṃ brāhmaṇe deyaṃ yannaivedye prakalpitam || 10 ||

items.text:
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ पालीव्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
तत्क्षणात्सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha pālīvratamuttamam ||
tatkṣaṇātsarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 11 ||

items.text:
संरुद्धशुद्धसलिलातिबलां विशालां पालीमुपेत्य बहुभिस्तरुभिः कृतालीम् ॥
ये पूजयंति वरुणं सहितं समुद्रैस्तेषां गृहे भवति भूतिरलब्धनाशा ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
saṃruddhaśuddhasalilātibalāṃ viśālāṃ pālīmupetya bahubhistarubhiḥ kṛtālīm ||
ye pūjayaṃti varuṇaṃ sahitaṃ samudraisteṣāṃ gṛhe bhavati bhūtiralabdhanāśā || 12 ||

en_summary: Yudhishthira asks why women of good families make offerings at tanks and large waters. Krishna says that in Bhadrapada, on the bright-half day named for the spirits, a fine arghya offering is given to Varuna on the bank of a tank; Brahmins, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, Shudras and women may all give it with devotion. One uses flowers, fruits, cloth, lamps, lac dye, sandal paste, uncooked food mixed with sesame and rice, dates, coconuts, citron, grapes, pomegranates and cucumbers. Varuna and his consort Varuni are drawn in a circle and worshipped with a short verse of homage, which also asks to be free of dampness, bad smell and a bad taste in the mouth. The worshipper bathes in the tank at midday, and the food offered is given to a Brahmin. The reward promised is release from all sins at once and a house where wealth is never lost.
